# pqblocks-hybrid-cert-validator

Composite X.509 hybrid certificate validator enforcing NSA CNSA 2.0 policy (RSA-3072 + ML-DSA-65) per draft-ietf-lamps-pq-composite-keys.

High-assurance composite X.509 hybrid certificate validator enforcing **NSA CNSA 2.0** transition and strict policies (**RSA-3072 + ML-DSA-65**) per **draft-ietf-lamps-pq-composite-keys §5**.
Part of the **PQBlocks** post-quantum suite. Maintained by **Govind Dubey** and The PQBlocks Authors under the Apache-2.0 license.

- **Area:** PQ cryptography
- **Install:** `pip install git+https://github.com/PQBlocks/hybrid-cert-validator`
- **Import:** `import pqblocks_hybrid_cert_validator.egg-info`
- **Command line:** `pqblocks-hybrid-cert-validate`
- **Native dependency:** none
- **Status:** 0.1.0 Stable, Python >=3.10
- **Docs:** https://pqblocks.github.io/packages/hybrid-cert-validator/ · repository https://github.com/PQBlocks/hybrid-cert-validator

## Quickstart (executed against the package)

```python
from pqblocks.hybrid_cert_validator import (
    HybridCertValidator,
    CompositePolicy,
    InvalidPEM,
    ValidationResult,
)

# Initialize validator with CNSA 2.0 Transition Policy
validator = HybridCertValidator(policy=CompositePolicy.CNSA20_TRANSITION)
assert validator.policy == CompositePolicy.CNSA20_TRANSITION

# Validate input with strict fail-safe exception handling
try:
    validator.validate(b"non-pem-data")
except InvalidPEM:
    pass  # Fail-safe rejection of invalid inputs
```
